title: ChapterCharacterRuntime
description: Artifact Contract (ADR-002) for a per-chapter CHARACTER RUNTIME: the standing of each LEAD character as the chapter opens. Like Story State (ADR-008), this is a PROJECTION, not mutable state: it is folded deterministically from the Registry's declarative facts (characters, relationships, events) up to the chapter's cursor event, plus the authored outline. Advancing the story never mutates a character's runtime -- it appends a fact (an event the lead participates in, a relationship that ends), and the projection recomputes; a lead's growth_stage advancing is a CONSEQUENCE of appearing in more events, not a written-back field. Where Story State projects the whole world at headline granularity, the Character Runtime zooms into the leads and makes each one's dramatic engine explicit: goal / pressure / secret / fear / desire / relationship_tension / growth_stage / next_likely_action. This is what lets the drafter keep a character's behavior CONTINUOUS across chapters (they act from a standing goal + pressure, not reinvented each chapter) and lets an editor trace growth causally. A Character Runtime is a DERIVED artifact (ADR-006): written to registry/derived/character-runtime/, never to registry/facts/, carrying provenance pinning the sources it was folded from so staleness is detectable. Schema validity is DETERMINISTIC and may gate a single runtime; the qualitative accuracy of goal/pressure/next_likely_action is EVALUATIVE and never gates (ADR-003). next_likely_action is a PREDICTION derived deterministically from goal+pressure; it CONSTRAINS the drafter (a plausible next move) but is advisory -- the chapter may legitimately subvert it.

up_to_event.description: The fold cursor: the last event id folded into this runtime (the leads' standing as they ENTER this chapter -- i.e. the previous chapter's event). null on the opening chapter (no prior events).

outline_ref.description: The outline artifact id the leads' goals/desires were drawn from, or null when no outline was available (goals then degrade to the character fact's arc/notes).

leads.description: One entry per LEAD character (protagonist + major roles). Deliberately NOT every character -- a bit player has no runtime engine worth carrying. Empty is legal (a project with no lead facts).

role.description: The lead's narrative role if the outline/fact declared one (protagonist/mentor/antagonist/...).

goal.description: What this character is pursuing right now -- the standing objective the drafter should have them act from. Folded from the outline (protagonist_engine.desire / character.motivation / arc) or the character fact's arc/notes.

pressure.description: The force pushing against the goal right now -- an active antagonistic relationship, an open threat, an unresolved setup the lead is entangled in. The source of dramatic tension the chapter should apply.

secret.description: Something the character knows/hides that the reader or other characters do not, if the facts/outline declared one. Drives dramatic irony.

fear.description: What the character most wants to avoid -- the flaw/cost side of the protagonist engine. Optional.

desire.description: The deeper want beneath the immediate goal (the emotional through-line). Optional; distinct from `goal` (tactical) -- desire is why the goal matters.

emotion.description: The lead's STANDING emotional state as the chapter opens, folded deterministically from pressure + growth_stage + active relationship tension (a consequence of the fold, not an authored/mutated field). Distinct from mandate.inner_shift, which is the per-chapter emotional MOVEMENT; this is the position before it. Optional.

belief.description: The core conviction driving the lead's choices, folded from the protagonist engine's desire + how far the growth_stage has come (early = tentative, late = hardened). Standing state, not movement. Optional.

value.description: The principle the lead prioritizes under pressure, taken from the outline where authored, else synthesized from the tension between desire and fear. Standing state. Optional.

decision_policy.description: How this lead characteristically decides under pressure (e.g. cautious/avoidant early, confronts head-on once transformed), folded deterministically from fear + growth_stage. Constrains continuous behavior; advisory. Optional.

relationship_tension.description: The lead's currently-active charged relationships (folded from REL facts not yet ended by their until_event), each summarizing the standing tension. This is what makes relationship change CAUSAL: a tension appears/ends because a fact did.

tension.description: The standing charge in one line.

growth_stage.description: A BUCKETED projection of how far the lead has come, derived from how many folded events they appear in (a consequence of the fold, not an authored/mutated field): introduced (just on stage) -> developing -> tested -> transformed. Lets an editor trace growth without a written-back counter.

appears_in.description: The folded events (up to the cursor) this lead participates in -- the fold evidence behind growth_stage. Bounded/ordered.

last_event.description: The most recent folded event the lead appeared in (their last on-stage moment before this chapter).

next_likely_action.description: A PLAUSIBLE next move for this lead, synthesized DETERMINISTICALLY from goal + pressure (no model). It CONSTRAINS the drafter toward continuous behavior (the lead acts from where they stand) but is ADVISORY (ADR-003): the chapter may subvert it deliberately. Not a fact, not a mandate.
